run: second board run of the day, with the full automation run RUN-20261118-094219-69c2 as evidence

findings.title: Traded suppliers take every RFQ slot, so the deal's own scored suppliers are never asked
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/continuations.py:563-595 _traded_suppliers_first puts every directory supplier with deals_won > 0 for the HS code first, then :560 caps the list at RFQ_MAX_SUPPLIERS (5). Automation RUN-20261118-094219-69c2: UC-15 / TC-E2E-000 failed 'each supplier gets the RFQ … {S1: 0, S2: 0}' while the safety guard refused 5 real directory addresses (exactly the cap) — five 'traded' companies filled the list
findings.fix: Reserve slots: at most 2 traded suppliers (RFQ_TRADED_MAX), the Match Engine's scored suppliers and the deal's own offers always get theirs, then rank the rest; log which supplier was dropped by the cap
findings.why_money: price competition on every RFQ — a new, cheaper supplier is asked instead of crowded out by old ones

findings.title: Staff relays that release money are not in the audit log, and some do not record who did them
findings.evidence: services/shield_link/router.py:265 api_record_milestone and :276 api_record_loading take no user; services/escrow_guard/router.py:218 open-window and :232 clear-dispute take no user; audit_log.record is called only for pi.extended, escrow.release_relayed_by_staff, approvals, directory.merge, screening, compliance.hold_cleared, kill_switch, prospect.dropped — not for the QC result relay (shield_link/router.py:170), a DELIVERED milestone (opens the acceptance window → final tranche auto-release), the loading record (unlocks T2 + freight), dispute clearance, supplier order confirmation / PO ack / goods-ready date by phone, party contact changes
findings.fix: Require the signed-in staff user on every relay route and write each one to audit_log with reason and evidence reference; show them in the deal timeline
findings.why_money: a disputed release can be defended, and a wrong one traced to a person, instead of written off

findings.title: Only one inspection is priced, however many the deal books
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/trade_costs.py:275 one inspection per deal; DUPRO / PEO can be added by the buyer (inspection_plan.py, deal.inspection_types) and a failed QC books a re-inspection (playbooks.py:82); services/escrow_guard/service.py:1969 books the inspection line once unless the provider order reports a fee; the rework notice (notifications.py:629) does not charge the supplier
findings.fix: One cost-sheet line per planned inspection phase (buyer band and walk-away follow); book each QC order in the ledger; charge a re-inspection after the supplier's own failure to the supplier (deducted from its payout, stated in the PO terms and the rework notice)
findings.why_money: DUPRO + PSI + PEO is ~USD 900-1,200 of inspection priced as ~USD 350; re-inspections stop coming out of the margin

findings.title: Phone / WhatsApp relays and radar data entry have no console screen
findings.evidence: extends todo line 422 (backend relays). No call in ../portless-ui/src for POST /deals/{id}/supplier-commitment/confirm, /next, /po-ack (gates the QC booking), POST /shield-link/deals/{id}/qc-readiness, POST /shield-link/qc/{ref}/status (SGS / BV results), /qc/poll, /qc/{tpo}/reschedule, POST /escrow-guard/escrows/{id}/tranches/{tid}/provider-confirmed, GET/PUT /deals/{id}/packing, GET /deals/{id}/cost-sheet, /market-check, PUT /trade-min/freight-lanes, GET /trade-min/profit/accuracy, POST /trade-min/screening/rescreen
findings.fix: Deal page 'Supplier said (by phone)' panel (confirm order, next supplier, PO acknowledged, goods-ready date, facility address — call note through askReason); QC card: record result, poll, reschedule; Payments: provider confirmed; packing, cost sheet and market check cards; radar settings: freight lane quotes and the accuracy table
findings.why_money: a deal never waits a day for a step the supplier already confirmed by phone

findings.title: The evidence pack leaves out compliance decisions, the audit trail and screening reviews
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/evidence.py has deal, parties, PI/PO, documents, orders, ledger, journal, approvals, exceptions, emails, timeline and party screening status — no compliance_checks / hold clearances, no audit_log entries for the deal, no directory screening_reviews (who cleared a possible sanctions match), no fees / FX, no cost sheet
findings.fix: Add sections: compliance (checks, holds, clearances with reason and person), audit (entries for the deal and its parties + chain verify result), screening reviews of both parties, fees and FX, cost sheet
findings.why_money: a frozen payment, bank query or customs audit is answered with one file instead of weeks

findings.title: Buyer and supplier e-mails make claims that are not always true
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/matchmaking.py:609 indicative offer: 'supplied by a GST- and IEC-verified Indian manufacturer' even when the pair's supplier is unverified (matchmaking.py:324-327) and 'the pre-shipment inspection by the agency you choose' (also trade_costs.py:356) while only QIMA is bookable (qc_providers.py:959); shared/company_profile.py:113 'Buyers who receive a good first shipment reorder through us' (a track record not yet earned) and :110 'you deliver FOB Indian port' while ex-works suppliers are collected by PortLess
findings.fix: Say 'verified' only when gst_verified and iec_active are True; name the bookable inspector; drop the reorder sentence; 'FOB Indian port or ex-works' for suppliers; add a test that scans every template for these phrases
findings.why_money: no dispute lost on a sentence PortLess wrote itself

findings.title: Eight automation cases fail and the test directory carries real e-mails and state between runs
findings.evidence: RUN-20261118-094219-69c2: 675 passed, 8 failed, 186 not automated, 135 browser. Failing: UC-15 + TC-E2E-000 (B-15), TC-PAY-002 (payouts_total 0, expected 18000), TC-PAY-014 (no balance payout gate after a partial payout), TC-LED-001 (deal realized_margin_usd None at settlement), TC-REL-016 (T4 SUBMITTED, catalogue expects RELEASED — provider release flow), TC-OUT-013 (C1 declined: a do-not-contact flag left in the directory by an earlier case), TC-RSK-075 (persona 'org-user' missing in services/automation/engine.py:101). All five money / outreach cases fail the same way on commit ec5920a, so they predate today's changes. The live scan keeps real supplier e-mails in trade_counterparties; the safety guard refused 5 of them
findings.fix: Fix each case (seeded payout / settlement legs, catalogue wording for the provider release, add the org-user persona); after the live scan the worker rewrites directory e-mails to .invalid and clears do-not-contact / traded state per case; target 0 failed before the nightly run is wired
findings.why_money: the money paths stay proven end to end, and no test run can ever address a real supplier

findings.title: FX gain / loss reaches the journal but not the realised margin
findings.evidence: fx_book.py gain / loss is posted only in services/escrow_guard/journal.py; services/escrow_guard/service.py realized_margin_usd, money_glance and trade_min/accuracy.py ignore it
findings.fix: fx_gain_loss_usd on the ledger, included in realized_margin_usd (so money_glance and accuracy follow)
findings.why_money: a 1-rupee move on a USD 40,000 payout is ~USD 470 the margin learning should see

findings.title: The indicative offer promises 7 days even when the supplier's quote behind it expires sooner
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/matchmaking.py:616 fixed 'valid for 7 days'; the pair knows the quote's remaining validity (matchmaking.py:345-346)
findings.fix: Validity = min(7, quote days left − 1) as a date; under 2 days reconfirm the quote before sending
findings.why_money: no offer outlives the cost it was priced on

findings.title: No cost per deal: LLM, Apify and operator time are not attributed to the deal
findings.evidence: shared/llm_gateway/tracker.py has no deal id; Apify spend is metered per scan (scan_cost), not per prospect / deal (enrichment, re-screen, contact refresh); todo 354 / 507 ask for budgets and dashboards, not attribution
findings.fix: Tag LLM calls and Apify runs with deal_id (context variable set by continuations and routes); count operator decisions and time-to-decide per deal; show cost per deal next to realised margin
findings.why_money: effort goes to the corridors whose margin covers their cost
